mito -use collections -data state.json src.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want.txt

-- state.json --
{
	"aye": {
		"value": 1
	},
	"bee": {
		"value": "two"
	},
	"one": [
		{
			"value": 1
		},
		{
			"value": "two"
		}
	],
	"two": [
		{
			"value": 3
		},
		{
			"value": "four"
		}
	]
}

-- src.cel --
[
	"one",
	"two",
].map(k, state[k].map(e, {
	k: e,
})).flatten().map(d, d.with({
	"aye": state.aye,
	"bee": state.bee,
}))
